pac_to_candidates: Open cycle: the published PAC panel's nowcast (R8) O + (1 - s) B: O the giving observed to the cut, B the prior cycle's total of the same roster, s the geometric mean of the share of each of the three prior cycles' totals given by the same date. The range is the same formula with each cycle's own share, lowest to highest; it is not a 95% interval. Industry revenue growth does not affect company PACs on either horizon (D-116); the next cycle chains from the nowcast.
general_giving: Open cycle stays on the model plus the observed-giving conditioning (P1): Mentat holds dated general giving for two complete cycles (2022, 2024), fewer than the three the pace test needs.
